items.example: Living abroad was a great experience.
items.exampleTr: Yurt dışında yaşamak harika bir deneyimdi.
items.simple: Something you did or saw. It stays in your head after.

items.example: Last weekend I visited my grandma.
items.exampleTr: Geçen hafta sonu büyükannemi ziyaret ettim.
items.simple: The two days at the end of the last week, just before now.

items.example: I went to the cinema with my friends.
items.simple: You say this to tell where you went and who came with you.

items.en: Did you have a good weekend?
items.example: Did you have a good weekend?
items.simple: You ask if the two days off were nice for someone.
items.note: Pazartesi sabahı en çok duyacağın soru.

items.example: I really enjoyed the concert.
items.simple: You like something and it makes you happy.

items.example: I met her two years ago.
items.simple: You say how long before today something was.

items.example: I've never been to London.
items.simple: You say you have not been to that place, not one time.
items.note: "been to" = oraya gidip dönmek. Hiç gitmediğini söylerken kullanılır.

items.example: Have you ever eaten sushi?
items.simple: At any time in your life, up to now.

items.example: Have you ever been abroad?
items.simple: You ask if someone did a thing at any time in their life.
items.note: Yaşam boyu deneyimi sorar; zaman söylemezsin.

items.example: I tried skiing once.
items.simple: One time only.

items.example: I have seen that film twice.
items.simple: Two times.

items.example: We lived there a long time ago.
items.exampleTr: Orada çok uzun zaman önce yaşadık.
items.simple: Many, many years before today.

items.example: What happened at the party?
items.simple: Something takes place. For example, a cup falls and breaks.

items.example: You look upset. What happened?
items.simple: You ask this when you see something is not right and want to know why.

items.example: I remember my first day at school.
items.simple: You have a thing in your head from before, and you can think of it.

items.example: I can't remember his name.
items.simple: You say this when you try to think of something, but it does not come back.
items.note: Hatırlamıyorum = I don’t remember. Hatırlayamıyorum = I can’t remember.

items.example: I forgot my keys this morning.
items.simple: You do not have a thing in your head from before anymore.

items.example: I lost my wallet on the bus.
items.simple: You had a thing, and now you cannot find it.

items.example: I used to play football every day.
items.simple: You did this a lot before, but you do not do it now.

items.example: I grew up in a small town.
items.simple: You get bigger and older, from a baby to a big person.

items.example: We ended up at my place.
items.simple: After many things, you get to a place you did not plan to be.
